scope: Sources and inherited evidence for the 31 October 2026 aerial-productivity screen. Products are hashed by run.py; original datasets and papers are not copied here.

local_inputs.use: Carbon allocations per class, geometry, mature replacement, class mixture, phosphorus stocks and pre-supply losses. These are engineered-organism screening scenarios, not observed organisms.
Older vertical atmosphere, water-use traits and gas/structure feasibility. Coupled traits and wet/dry trajectories remain unvalidated.
Shared Earth-analogue phosphorus fallout and optical/physiological precedent; see its sources.json for the original access record.
Surface reference18.7877Gt C/year, separate from all sky production, and provisional light adjustment; see biomass_comparison_inputs.json for climate provenance.

published_sources.citation: Dillon KP et al. (2020), Cyanobacteria and Algae in Clouds and Rain in the Area of puy de Dome, Central France
published_sources.use: Viable oxygenic phototrophs occur in cloud/rain samples; supports biological precedent, not a demonstrated airborne autotrophic production rate or lunar carrying capacity.

published_sources.citation: Peguilhan R et al. (2025), Clouds influence the functioning of airborne microorganisms
published_sources.access: Publisher abstract and indexed results/discussion excerpts read 2026-10-31; no claim of complete source review
published_sources.use: Metabolic activity depends on cloud-water conditions; Eulerian atmospheric depth or cloud presence does not establish a complete productive aerial life cycle.

published_sources.citation: Mercado LM et al. (2009), Impact of changes in diffuse radiation on the global land carbon sink
published_sources.access: Publisher/repository indexed records inspected; publisher open failed. No numerical inputs taken from this paper for the new screen.
published_sources.use: Context only for the distinction between diffuse redistribution and extra photons; local canopy products supply the numerical response assumptions.

new_scenario_choices: Sum projected area at1,2,5,10,20,30,50 and100percent of lunar area; no coverage selected or assigned probability.
Poisson vertical-beam interception, with mixed or class-stratified positions; no angular or cloud radiative simulation.
Mature adult hazard0.003/year; low-maintenance photolytic reference bodies, existing50/30/20 class mix.

Habitat-specific surface elasticities0.65 wet margins,0.6 productive coasts,0.1 oligotrophic waters,0.8 for rainfed light potential. They approximate inherited model response ranges; no new calibration.
Half of unallocated assimilate converted to tissue is a potential allocation only, requiring nutrients and a destination for mass; excluded from headline incremental production.
Microbial columns use prescribed0.2 favourable duty and3.6-day doubling; a separate optimistic engineered case uses0.5 duty and1-day doubling. Neither is measured lunar photoautotrophic performance.

scattering_context.use: Existing diffuse and underside light evidence, used to interpret the missing whole-sky angular transport. No added numerical production multiplier.
scattering_context.claims: Old clear-sky diffuse PAR37/56/80percent at solar elevations90/30/10degrees; canopy baseline explicitly includes diffuse illumination; at10km lone underside19–30percent and reef underside11–22percent of top horizontal light over ground albedo0.05–0.2. These do not establish attenuation or production in a crowded aerial community.
